messages.subject: How to extract dispersal events matrix from BioGeoBEARS results
parts:
Hi Nick,

If I use BioGeoBEARS for a lot of clades and I want to know how many specific events (like, dispersal from A to B) and their time interval. I cannot count it one by one because of the huge data. How could I do it? Is there any avaliable code in BioGeoBEARS can do that?

Thanks!

Wei Xu

I think Nick can provide more details, but it sounds like stochastic character mapping is probably what you want:

http://phylo.wikidot.com/biogeographical-stochastic-mapping-example-script

Best,

Joel
